outcome_detail: Agent reverse-engineered orbiting satellites animation from reference video, producing 108-line Revideo scene with mean SSIM 0.9694 across 60 sampled frames. Final reward 0.7103 composed of gated SSIM 0.7239, pHash 0.9812, duration 1.0.
strategy: Extract frames, track colored blobs, fit parametric orbit models, iteratively refine
agent_behavior: Methodically extracted all 361 reference frames and analyzed pixel colors using numpy/PIL/scipy to identify 10 colored orbiting circles plus one central orange circle.
Used connected-component analysis and centroid tracking across all frames to determine per-ball orbit radii, angular velocities, and starting angles.
Discovered 4-phase animation structure (steady orbit, radius growth, steady peak, accelerating reverse spin) through careful unwrapped-angle and radius-vs-time analysis.
Identified angular velocity multipliers (k=1,2,3,3,4,5,6,7,9,11 times base omega) and phase-4 quadratic acceleration formula through curve fitting.
Initially missed the red ball (k=1, smallest orbit, partially occluded by orange center) but discovered and added it after analyzing residual pixel differences.
Identified y-axis clamping at +/-150 pixels from center to handle balls going off-canvas, improving match for outer orbits like lavender.
Tuned ball sizes per-color, orange radius, video duration, and RGB color values through multiple render-compare cycles to minimize per-pixel differences from avg 8.98 down to 2.798.
Used 148 episodes over ~60 minutes of agent execution, costing $13.49 in API calls.
